title: Google Pixel 6 Pro device identity metadata
description: Device identity only: replays the SystemInfo android_build_fingerprint, android_device_manufacturer, android_soc_model, android_sdk_version that a Google Pixel 6 Pro capture recorded, over the android-scroll-customer real base. It is not a Google Pixel 6 Pro trace: apart from this identity and the case marker slice, every packet comes from the base.
known_issues: Derived metadata, not a device trace: only android_build_fingerprint, android_device_manufacturer, android_soc_model, android_sdk_version come from the Google Pixel 6 Pro capture; processes, scheduling, slices and all other metadata belong to the android-scroll-customer base.
The source capture is kept outside this repository. Its device serial number and every other per-unit identifier were removed; only build-level identity is kept.

android.device: Google Pixel 6 Pro identity over OPPO PKH110 base

source.origin: SmartPerfetto deterministic trace generator; device identity values copied from a maintainer device capture that is not committed
